published_ranges._notes: PA6 ('Easy PA'). Listing: 'supports printing as low as 220C, speeds up to 200 mm/s' with drying before each print; melting temperature up to 194C; tensile 56 MPa; elongation at break 25%; notched Izod 50 kJ/m2. yxpolyer.com PA6 Red/Blue pages: 'easy printing at 220C'; PA6 Black page: up to 200 mm/s when properly dried. No upper nozzle temperature, bed, drying or density published.
